test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'RELAX' is written as 'CPPZC' and 'STAKE' is written as 'RQEGM'. How will 'WINDS' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First two letters → (2) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series diagonally.
 
• third letter → (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Last two letters → (2) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series diagonally.

So,

 
• 'RELAX' is written as 'CPPZC'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9f6950868e294314d4745a0e57029aa22c616b5e9436988e38b83b4485cf71d.png] 

And,

 
• 'STAKE' is written as 'RQEGM'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1dce26920780f981da397b1e6c006d5b08af1c768ffdbd9b5db5ecb79a656fbc.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'WINDS' will be written as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4ce19f8a92e564cafbd18890ff670900780a3376f06bead36c39d03afa6b6a9d.png] 

​Hence, "**GURUF**" is the correct answer.

71
